name: midjourney
description: Midjourney MCP server for Claude Code and AI agents. 32 tools for generating images, following jobs to completion, downloading the real files, and browsing your library and the explore feeds.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Midjourney.

Midjourney publishes no API, so this drives a real Chrome signed in as you, in a browser profile of its own. There is no key to paste and no cookie to export: you sign in once, in a window, and the session persists.

Generating costs GPU time from a paid plan and cannot be refunded, so every tool that spends refuses to run without an explicit confirmation. Read Only hides them entirely.

Midjourney's terms do not permit automated access, so this carries a risk to the account, as any unofficial client does.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that can spend GPU time. Reading your jobs, library and the explore feeds still works.

default_speed.title: Default speed
default_speed.description: fast burns fast-hours and returns in under a minute. relax is unlimited on Standard and above but queues. turbo is quickest and costs double.
